svg.title: Parcel Delivery customer flow, from Home to Delivery Complete
svg.desc: Flowchart: order setup screens, fare estimate and payment, searching for a driver, a single consolidated live-tracking screen covering every delivery status, then delivered, receipt, rating and completion.
